theme: A free day in Dubrovnik before the charter.
greeting: The calendar is wide open, Dan - you're in Dubrovnik with the day to yourself. Worth spending a little of it on the pieces that get harder once you're on the water Saturday.

needsAttention.title: Confirm boarding with your instructor
needsAttention.detail: The Nautilus charter boards Saturday and connectivity goes dark once underway - lock the meeting time and place, and arrange the Sept 19 return transfer to the airport, while you're still on land.

needsAttention.title: Nail down the Cavtat pieces
needsAttention.detail: Three things to arrange before Saturday: the Sept 19 transfer from Komolac to Cavtat, a bag hold ahead of the 3 PM check-in, and a 5:15 AM checkout on the 20th for the 7:30 flight.

needsAttention.title: Reserve the Sept 20 to Oct 5 rental car
needsAttention.detail: No longer a hedge - book the Full Size SUV at TPA now, so you're not at a walk-up counter, jet-lagged, on a Sunday.

flagged.title: The Nomura intro thread is still warm
flagged.detail: Mike Lubrano wants a call about the Chie/Nomura work - nothing owed while you're at sea.

inbox.noise: Otherwise it's newsletters and receipts - Rancho Gordo, a Hilton statement, your language lessons.

resolved.title: Carol Hansell reconnect
resolved.detail: She replied 'let's talk when you're back' - set for after the 19th, nothing owed now.

resolved.title: Cavtat hotel confirmed
resolved.detail: Remisens Epidaurus came through Sept 9 - booking 5547387205.

recipe.why: Autumn brings chestnuts, winter squash, and game birds to the table.

acts.line: No meetings on the calendar - an open morning in the Old Port apartment.
The land-side charter errands: instructor, transfers, and provisions before Saturday.
Dubrovnik is yours tonight; the boat boards Saturday at five.
